key.name: enabled
key.description: Play a short sound when the screen locks (power key, screen timeout, Lock) and when the lock screen is dismissed. Never in Silent Mode, with Do Not Disturb on, during calls or when the proximity sensor turns the screen off.

key.name: lock-sound
key.description: A bundled sound id (pop-down, pop-up, click, soft-click, tick, tap, chime, chime-low, slick), an absolute path of an audio file, or empty for no sound.

key.name: unlock-sound
key.description: As lock-sound, played when the lock screen goes away after the passcode, fingerprint or swipe.

key.name: prepared-files
key.description: Written by fp6-lock-sounds: pairs of [source path, prepared 16-bit WAV in ~/.cache/fp6-lock-sounds] for the custom sounds in lock-sound and unlock-sound, so Lomiri can preload them.
